verdict.text: Discogs doesn't know when this was pressed

notes.text:
) pressing, vinyl looks black but is actually red translucent when held above a bright light. 

The rear sleeve has red text on track titles and black on the rest. Gull Records address detail at bottom and “Made and printed in England” bottom left. This is the second and last issue on the Gull label. 
 “Gull Songs” publishing credits after each song title on the label.
Side A and B titles changed places on back of sleeve. 

Track A2: listed as "Ripper" on back sleeve, and "The Ripper" on label.
Track A3: listed as "Dreamer Deceiver" on back sleeve, and "Dream Deceiver" on label.
Distributed by Pye Records (Sales) Ltd
Made and printed in England.

℗ & © 1976 Gull Records, a division of Gull Entertainments Limited, London.
℗ 1976
